depends_on.name: software_id
depends_on.documentation: The implementation of the acquisition system itself (v1's `daqsystem.ndi_daqsystem_class`, e.g. 'ndi.daq.system.mfdaq', became an edge rather than a string field -- the same fold `epoch_file_pattern` and `epoch_parameter_reader` make of their own class names). It is the object-reconstruction key read at +ndi/+database/+fun/ndi_document2ndi_object.m:38-42 through a CONSTRUCTED field name, so no literal grep finds the reader. Distinct from `reader_id`, which names a DIFFERENT component.

depends_on.name: reader_id
depends_on.documentation: The reader this system acquires through. REPOINTED from `software` to `acquisition_reader`: the parenthesis here used to read "it is the only one of the four with no parameters of its own", and that was the error -- `reader_string` is a parameter of its own, and pointing straight at `software` left it homeless (both PRED `daqreader_ndr` documents carry one). The edge now has the same shape as `epoch_parameter_reader_id`: a reader class that owns its configuration and points on at the `software` that implements it. REQUIRED (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [required acquisition edges]): ndi.daq.system cannot be built without it, and every writer fills it (the Haley import always; the migrator from v1, where it was required).

depends_on.name: epoch_file_pattern_id
depends_on.documentation: The rule that decides which files form one epoch on this system. REQUIRED (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [required acquisition edges]): ndi.daq.system cannot be built without it, and every writer fills it (the Haley import always; the migrator from v1, where it was required).

depends_on.name: epoch_parameter_reader_id
depends_on.documentation: The reader(s) of the epoch's parameter files (stimulus parameters, in every NDI reader today), if any.

depends_on.name: device_id
depends_on.documentation: REQUIRED (Jess Haley 2026-11-19 [device id required and named by the rig] (1), did_v2_standing_wiring_plan.md: required once DID-matlab #498 and NDI-matlab #1278 merged and every corpus fills it; and Jess Haley 2026-11-22 [rig device written by NDI writers]: NDI's own v2 writers create the rig device and fill this edge, NDI-matlab #1299): the device this configuration reads the files of -- the rig itself (a digitizer, a camera, a computer), an entity of type device. Jess Haley 2026-11-19 [acquisition system is a device entity] (did_v2_standing_wiring_plan.md): the digitizer is the device entity, and this document is the separate configuration (v1 navigator, reader and parameter reader) that points at it by this edge; a probe's `connected to` wiring and a rig's clock ([a rig's clock belongs to its device]) name the device, not this document. Migration fills it with the device it mints per rig per session, named by the v1 rig name ([migration mints the device by name], [one device per session]; DID-matlab #498). the same entity as an interaction's `instrument_id` when one device does both, with no rule tying the two (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [instrument and device]). Filled when known (the Haley import's camera, `instrumentFor` in sessionDocuments.m). The acquisition system itself is configuration -- which software reads which files -- not a thing in the world. An epoch reaches its system through the recording interaction's `acquisition_system_id` (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [epoch to system link], no `recorded_by` relation; amended 2026-11-01 [probe wiring is a relation], which retired the `acquisition_channels` document in between); a probe's channels on the system are its `connected to` directed_relation to the device.

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The rig's name (v1 `daqsystem.base.name`, #73 item 54). An acquisition_configuration is how a device's recordings are read: its reader (`reader_id`), epoch file pattern (`epoch_file_pattern_id`), epoch parameter readers (`epoch_parameter_reader_id`), software (`software_id`) and device (`device_id`); `acquisition_system` until Jess Haley's decision of 2026-11-19 [acquisition configuration renamed] (did_v2_standing_wiring_plan.md). NDI finds an acquisition configuration by this name (session.m daqsystem_load; a syncrule's daqsystem1_name / daqsystem2_name name it), so migrators must carry it.
